facts: Existing shared loop requires complete frame/scope pixel equality for snapshot-tap, which also covers unrelated blinking search text cursor.

Actual native accessibility click first resolves and refreshes the exact leaf twice, but then climbs up to the first clickable ancestor (at most100); checks same package/window and ancestor visible/enabled/refresh. It does not bind that ancestor to a ContactList item or compare its full identity twice.

The frozen Contacts observed row contract explicitly permits non-clickable ViewGroup inside android:id/list and non-clickable cliv_name_textview. Therefore no actionable row ancestor has been established by this source alone.

Actual native click with method=mouse uses the same twice-unique-resolved and refreshed leaf, then the fresh leaf bounds center. It requires that center inside verified focused application-window bounds, injects one SOURCE_MOUSE down/up pair synchronously, and returns method=mouse/source=native_bounds_mouse/coordinates/target/actual_target.

Native actionAttempted is set before injection; failure retains unknown effect. A defensive UP on DOWN exception is release cleanup, not permission to replay the click. Mouse success does not prove business success.

Actual helper dispatch accepts method=mouse only for click and forwards it unchanged. It captures the scoped application before native action; post-capture failure is explicitly unknown. Shared snapshot-tap code need not change.

Installed Contacts binds android:id/list OnItemClickListener; generic item click hides keyboard, subtracts headers and dispatches adapter position. Default handler gets cursor-backed contact lookup URI, marks search-result click and calls viewContact; listener eventually invokes startQuickContact for that exact URI.

ContactListAdapter.bindNameAndViewId binds display name and cursor-backed view ID. Its ContactListItemView implementation was not included in this selected source capture; no custom accessibility action is assumed.
